mechanism_analysis.cancellation_robustne.reason: The report separately analyzes qc, G1, and G2, distinguishes deterministic cancellation from independent sampling variance, and measures forward/backward energy-drift cancellation. mechanism_analysis.dominant_source_ident.reason: Channel isolation shows two-qubit depolarization and relaxation/dephasing dominate, with small single-qubit/readout contributions. failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: Observed failures are tied to specific mechanisms: systematic bias persists with additional shots, large-noise circular wrapping produces nonmonotonic errors, contrast loss biases the one-quadrature estimator, and noisy metric estimates trigger excessive growth.
